item.title: From the Manse: Going Deeper
item.description:
Begins Tomorrow!
From The Manse: 
               An Update for All Things FCC
          Saturday begins the first of a three-part series called Going Deeper.  Together we will engage in spiritual conversation and exploration.  These are not conversations from which we hope to “convert” people to our way of thinking.  Instead, the conversations are built around silence and listening, so that we can delve deeper into our experience of the Holy and explore heart-essential issues such as faith, spirituality, doubt, trust, and surrender.  Our conversation partners are fellow travelers on the path, offering perspective, care, and support. 
          The spiritual path is one that requires both solitude and companionship.  In today’s world we’re not encouraged to think very deeply about spirituality and our relationship with God, certainly not within the context of community.  Spirituality can almost feel like a commodity in today’s world - and spiritual companionship a saleable product.

          It’s not a commodity, and you don’t have to travel alone.  Join us on these three Saturday mornings for the adventure!
In God's Peace,
Jessica

August 16, 2026
10:00 Worship in the Sanctuary
Bulletin

A Special Note of Gratitude From All of Us At FCC

  • Greg Beeman, Bonnie Bosley, Jo Ann Chambers, Sandy Cristman, Alice Drislane, Paula Kane, Doug & Carol Klette, Stephen McLaughlin, Tony & Val Odrechowski, Marina Perron, Chauncey Scates, Dick Thayer, Ira WIlkens, Jonathan - Thank You for helping to make the Church Street Celebration such a wonderful success! 
  • Sandy Cristman - Thank You for organizing a conversation about an emerging Sunday School program - and to Rachel Duncan, Nancy Newton, and Jessica Pecor for joining in!

 

Going Deeper: Spiritual Conversations

August 15, 22, and 29
10am -noon

What is faith? How can we live a more Christian life? 

What is the meaning of Life, the Universe, and Everything . . .  

The spiritual path is best traveled with companions. Join us for open, explorative conversations on faith as we go deeper together!

Space is limited - please let Pastor Jessica know if you'd like to join the conversation!

Mindful Awareness with Jonathan:

Thursday mornings 8-9am in the Sanctuary

Free 

Explore present-centered awareness and insight through acceptance and letting go.  Everyone is welcome.
 

Bible Study:
ON SUMMER VACATION
